I was told this was due to items being on preorder but there was no mention of this during the checkout process. Express shipping is a rip off!!

reviews.review_title: I ordered a bunch of clothes on June…
reviews.review_text: I ordered a bunch of clothes on June 11th, and they did not ship out for over a month. I had to go into my order and click to request that it be shipped out faster, and it shipped the next day. I am so confused why it took me doing that to ship the order, I have never seen another retailer do that. The quality of the clothes that arrived were also awful, some were okay, but many were just loose fitting plastic garbage. I will be returning most of the order, and never ordering again.
reviews.reply_text:
Hello,
We're truly sorry to hear about your experience. We understand how frustrating it must have been to wait so long for your order and feel that you had to manually request the shipment before it was dispatched. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience caused.
We would like to confirm that we have received your email, and our relevant team has processed this matter.
Thank you for your patience and for giving us the opportunity to make things right.

reviews.review_title: I did not enjoy the items and then…
reviews.review_text: I did not enjoy the items and then struggled being able to return them. Additionally I tried to delete a secondary account because after I signed in, I realized that I had made a different account on my phone that was attached to the order. I understand why it took so long for the items to come, but it was 2 months. For two pairs of pants. That is too long. The pants don't actually fit that well and they were very dependent on the body you have in order to look good. My experience after purchase has been awful getting up to two emails a day despite it being stated on the bottom of the email that it was the last email regarding viewing. I did talk to customer service. No the bot nor the human were able to help me and said I should call or email. The email was not replied to either. No I don't care to resolve anything further. I will not complain about the clothes to others either because that happens being a woman and buying pants. I will complain about amount of emails and the lack of actually being able to delete your account. I had a truly not good experience and I am sorry for wasting so much money, time, and effort on it.
reviews.reply_text:
